lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Hey Rahul, Maya from CallForge. Thanks for making time between patients. I know front desk mornings are chaos.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: No problem. Honestly I've been meaning to look at this for a while, so your timing is decent.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Tell me what's happening today. You're running five locations on RingHawk, right?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Yeah, all five are on RingHawk and have been for about three years. And look, the system works until it doesn't. Calls drop mid transfer between locations at least a few times a day now.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: After hours is the real bleed. Anything after six just rings out and goes to a voicemail nobody checks until morning. We lose maybe ten bookings a week that way. A cleaning patient calls at seven, nobody answers, they book with whoever picks up the phone.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: That's real money at five locations. What have you tried?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: We asked RingHawk for after-hours routing last year. The support tickets go nowhere. You wait four days and get a reply asking you to restart the router. I'm done filing them.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Understood. Can I ask about budget, just so I don't waste your time later?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: We do not have a budget problem, honestly. It's a trust problem. I got burned once switching software and I'm not doing that dance again without proof it works.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Fair. What does your RingHawk renewal look like?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: It's coming up and honestly it's just too expensive for what we're getting. They bumped the price again this year and the service got worse.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Okay. One more thing — compliance. You're texting patients?

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: We want to. My office manager keeps asking about text reminders, but I keep hearing letters like TCPA and I don't want to be the test case. So today we just don't text at all.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: That's exactly the kind of thing our compliance tooling handles. Here's what I'd suggest — a proper demo, thirty minutes, I'll show you the after-hours routing and the compliant texting flow live.

lines.speaker: prospect
lines.text: Alright. Do it Thursday, before the lunch rush. And keep it practical, I don't need a slideshow.

lines.speaker: rep
lines.text: Thursday it is. I'll bring the routing demo and the texting flow, no slides.
